verdict.rationale: Groq documents OpenAI-compatible base_url swap (groq-docs-2, groq-docs-25, groq-docs-33) which is the standard mechanism many coding agents/agent frameworks use to plug in a provider, plus first-party tool-use/function-calling docs (groq-docs-5, groq-docs-27) and remote MCP server support letting Groq orchestrate agent tools without custom logic (groq-docs-6, groq-docs-28, groq-probe-4). However there are no named first-party integration guides for specific coding-agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Cursor, AutoGPT) in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit framework-specific integration guides, independent hands-on confirmation of agent-framework compatibility.
